title: Acid-phase protection of low-carbon steel by DIMC: evidenced by WL/PDP/EIS and density-functional modeling
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,47545-47564
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07780J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sherin A. M. Ali, Mostafa E. Salem, Mostafa A. A. Mahmoud, Mansour Alsarrani, Mohamed Abdel-Megid, H. A. El Nagy, Ahmed Z. Ibrahim
DIMC forms a stable adsorbed film on low-carbon steel in 0.5 M HCl, achieving 91.4% inhibition at 300 ppm (298 K). WL/PDP/EIS and DFT/Monte Carlo confirm a mixed physisorption chemisorption mechanism.
